The document-envelope schedule, identical to every other flow kind: parsed by YamlDocumentLoader before the flowType dispatch (src/SqlFlow.Yaml/YamlDocumentLoader.cs), carried on the projected pipeline header, mirrored into the catalog by the estate sync, and fired by the control plane's SchedulerService onto the normal run queue. This is how a snapshot runs unattended: a nightly cron on the flow, or a reference joining a named schedule. A schema registration flow is deliberately excluded from the lineage graph, so it never joins a wave; a schedule that names it fires it directly.
